name: bench-matrix
title: Bench Matrix
description: Vendor-announcement style benchmark board: benchmark rows grouped by domain vs model columns, with a tinted hero column and bold best-in-row plates.

meta.question: How do these models compare across many benchmarks at once?
meta.whenToUse: Comparing a handful of models across many named benchmarks in one glance, especially when one model is the protagonist.
meta.antiUse: Trends over time or more than ~6 models — use a time-series form or a ranking board instead of a wide table.
